_about: Persona 5 teardown (mhvnsnt/teardown-persona5, PR-P1) — the v2 register data carrier for the Persona UI dialect. The v1 fragment (persona-dialect-fragment.json, mochiichao/ui-dialect/v1) remains the law document; v2 is the implementation-data extension and never silently edits v1's meaning. Shapes are defined in TypeScript in src/lib/dialectRegister.ts (RegisterRecord / PresentationEvent / ResolvedRegister, from the dialect lane's WIRING-PACKAGE §§2-4) and summarised here as the data home. Ships with ZERO records: register content is authored per scene/beat at wiring time, in story order, under the locked-content fence (locked Ink/dialogue files are never edited to add register data).

shapes.presentationEvent: { id, kind (objective|discovery|bond|honor|rank|unlock|notice), registerClass, headline, body?, glyphId? (null until the glyph set ships), priority, durationMs, dedupeKey (required), sourceSystem (required), beatId?, threshold? { from, to, subjectId } — band labels only, never a stored number }
shapes.registerRecord: { class (none|C|B|A|jax), band, fictionKey? (required for A), devices[] (closed enum of 7), heroMove?, slant?, attribution (none|display|signed; none mandatory for C), beatId? }
